description: CR 121.4 a player who can't draw has not attempted to draw from an empty library, and does not lose
note: Bob's library is empty through his draw step. Without Maralen of the Mornsong CR 704.5b ends the game before his main phase; with it nothing was attempted (its 2008-04-01 ruling), the trigger costs him 3 life and finds nothing, and the game goes on.
